implementationScope: package-only progressive JFIF 4:2:0 incremental session with semantic-unit transport, cadence-aware output/render lifetime, first-SOS DQT release, actual-only coefficient planes and exact current Huffman retained payloads under a separate eight-slot maximum admission authority

cases.mechanismPressure: single-byte scheduling observes DHT redefinitions between scans while final retained state contains only four exact 16+N payloads instead of eight 272-byte capacities
optimized progressive tables grow and shrink substantially across scans; current retained DHT payload must fall independently of the unchanged worst-case future admission authority
restart-heavy suspension proves dynamic DHT ownership composes with split restart markers and MCU rollback without altering entropy or RGB output

requiredInvariants: All v8 transport, source-authority, DQT lifetime, actual coefficient geometry, output cadence, RenderArena and transactional-MCU invariants remain unchanged.
persistentBaseFixedStateByteCount is exactly 576 bytes: 384 bytes of bound component dequantization values plus 192 bytes of progression precision.

One present Huffman slot retains exactly 16 code-length count bytes plus its currently declared symbol bytes; absent selectors and unused symbol capacity do not contribute to current codec-owned semantic byte charge.

maximumHuffmanTablePayloadByteCount remains 272 bytes and maximumHuffmanStateByteCount remains 2176 bytes for eight possible slots. This maximum is used for future-safe operation admission even when current retained payload is much smaller.
StatePlan.persistentStateBytes remains the maximum authority coefficientStateBytes + 576 + 2176; StateArena retained state is coefficientStateBytes + 576 + current Huffman payloads.
DHT redefinition resizes only the selected retained payload and preserves every other slot. The current retained total and historical high-water are independently observable from session snapshots.

For a potential table replacement, operation qualification remains conservative: the overall phase maximum also covers one 272-byte replacement payload in addition to maximum persistent state. Render-phase bounds dominate that mutation term in the retained evidence cases.

The tiny source finishes with 90 bytes of DHT payload and reaches a 95-byte DHT high-water. Its every-preview retained state is 3257 bytes while maximum retained authority remains 5343 bytes and operation peak remains 8095 bytes.
The 576x576 source finishes with 98 DHT bytes, reaches 169 bytes, retains 996416 bytes before finish, has maximum retained authority 998494 bytes and operation peak 2010910 bytes.
The restart64 source finishes with 89 DHT bytes, reaches 135 bytes, retains 13367 bytes before finish, has maximum retained authority 15454 bytes and operation peak 30494 bytes.
Actual retainedBetweenCalls must use current DHT payloads; operationPeak must continue to use maximum future Huffman authority. The validator rejects any report that substitutes one for the other.
Terminal finish/cancel/fatal failure still publishes zero codec-owned retained/operation/output state.
This profile does not qualify malloc headers, allocator size classes, Swift object headers, physical RSS, non-JFIF semantics, embedded ICC, other sampling modes or perceptual reconstruction quality.
